# SQS

Use queues with visibility timeouts, long polling, FIFO ordering, and dead-letter workflows.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `sqs` |
| Signing name | `sqs` |
| Wire protocol | AWS JSON 1.0, AWS Query |
| API version | `2012-11-05` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Local behavior |
| Selected operations | 23 of 23 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#sqs) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- No throughput enforcement or queue resource-policy evaluation.
- No message groups on standard queues or FIFO message move tasks.
- DeleteQueue does not enforce the AWS name-reuse delay.
- Purge completes immediately instead of an asynchronous deletion window; FIFO deduplication history is retained.
- In verify mode, console management requires an authenticated root console session; without a session only queue inventory is available.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
